_comment: VOM compat. Conquest's `op:remove /textures` strips these ore blocktypes, so VOM's own `op:add /textures/cube|ore1ByType` silently fails -> its 3D vein shapes have no #cube/#ore1 mapping and render the pink/black placeholder. We `addmerge` onto the PARENT /textures (which resolves to the block root and so works even when /textures was removed), re-adding a gap-free `cube` for every ore/rock combo plus VOM's ore1 lump mapping. Texture refs are UNQUALIFIED = game domain (base survival/ content registers under game:, exactly as VOM references it; a `survival:` domain does not resolve at runtime). The cube base uses Conquest's own rock art (conquest/{rock}/sides/1, present for all 24 rocks) so the surrounding stone matches the pack instead of VOM's vanilla {rock}1. This mod is Universal so the patch applies SERVER-side where blocktype JSON lives (a client-only mod's patch has no target and silently misses). Gated dependsOn visibleoresandminerals; applies after Conquest's remove because this mod hard-depends on conquest (loads later).
